privacyPage.sectionCollectBody: We collect information you provide when registering (email, username, name) and when using the service (game scores, preferences).

privacyPage.sectionCookiesBody: We use session cookies and local storage for authentication and preferences. These are essential for the service to function.
privacyPage.sectionContactBody: For privacy-related questions, please contact us through the support channel provided in the app.
